taxpayer_name.rationale: ProprietorNm is the leaf element for the taxpayer/proprietor name; NameOfProprietor (idx 39) appears to be a legacy/duplicate, but ProprietorNm is the preferred canonical leaf.

taxpayer_ssn.rationale: SSN (idx 52) and SocialSecurityNumber (idx 53) both represent the taxpayer SSN; SSN is the more canonical MeF leaf name for this field.

area_used_exclusively_for_business.rationale: BusinessUseSquareFeetCnt directly corresponds to Line 1 square footage used for business.

total_area_of_home.rationale: TotalAreaOfHomeCnt directly corresponds to Line 2 total square footage of the home.

business_use_percentage.rationale: BusinessSquareFeetPct corresponds to Line 3, the business-use percentage (area ratio).

daycare_hours_available.rationale: TotalHoursAvailableCnt corresponds to Line 4, total hours the daycare facility was available.

hours_used_for_daycare.rationale: BusinessUseHoursCnt corresponds to Line 5, hours actually used for daycare.

daycare_time_percentage.rationale: BusinessHoursPct corresponds to Line 6, the daycare time-use percentage (hours ratio).

applicable_percentage.rationale: BusinessPct corresponds to Line 7, the applicable percentage used throughout Part II.

tentative_profit_loss.rationale: HomeBusinessIncomeAmt corresponds to Line 8, tentative profit or loss from the business.

casualty_losses.rationale: CasualtyLossPortionAmt corresponds to Line 9, casualty losses attributable to business use of the home.

deductible_mortgage_interest_direct.rationale: DeductibleMortgageIntDirectAmt corresponds to Line 10 Direct column for deductible mortgage interest.

deductible_mortgage_interest_indirect.rationale: DeductibleMortgageIntIndrAmt corresponds to Line 10 Indirect column for deductible mortgage interest.

real_estate_taxes_direct.rationale: RealEstateTaxesDirectAmt corresponds to Line 11 Direct column for real estate taxes.

real_estate_taxes_indirect.rationale: RealEstateTaxesIndirectAmt corresponds to Line 11 Indirect column for real estate taxes.

subtract_lines_9_through_11_from_8.rationale: CsltyLossesAndDeprecLimitAmt corresponds to Line 12, the remaining income limit after subtracting Lines 9–11.

excess_mortgage_interest_direct.rationale: ExcessMortgageIntDirectAmt corresponds to Line 13 Direct column for excess mortgage interest.

excess_mortgage_interest_indirect.rationale: ExcessMortgageIntIndirectAmt corresponds to Line 13 Indirect column for excess mortgage interest.

insurance_direct.rationale: InsuranceDirectAmt corresponds to Line 14 Direct column for insurance premiums.

insurance_indirect.rationale: InsuranceIndirectAmt corresponds to Line 14 Indirect column for insurance premiums.

rent_direct.rationale: RentDirectAmt corresponds to Line 15 Direct column for rent paid.

rent_indirect.rationale: RentIndirectAmt corresponds to Line 15 Indirect column for rent paid.

repairs_and_maintenance_direct.rationale: RepairsAndMaintDirectAmt corresponds to Line 16 Direct column for repairs and maintenance.

repairs_and_maintenance_indirect.rationale: RepairsAndMaintIndirectAmt corresponds to Line 16 Indirect column for repairs and maintenance.

utilities_direct.rationale: UtilitiesDirectAmt corresponds to Line 17 Direct column for utility costs.

utilities_indirect.rationale: UtilitiesIndirectAmt corresponds to Line 17 Indirect column for utility costs.

other_expenses_direct.rationale: OtherExpensesDirectAmt corresponds to Line 18 Direct column for other expenses.

other_expenses_indirect.rationale: OtherExpensesIndirectAmt corresponds to Line 18 Indirect column for other expenses.

add_lines_13_through_18_direct.rationale: DirectDeductedExpnssSubtlAmt corresponds to Line 19 Direct column subtotal of Lines 13–18.

add_lines_13_through_18_indirect.rationale: IndirectDeductedExpnssSubtlAmt corresponds to Line 19 Indirect column subtotal of Lines 13–18.

multiply_indirect_by_percentage.rationale: AllowableIndrDeductedExpnssAmt corresponds to Line 20, indirect expenses multiplied by the applicable percentage.

add_direct_and_multiplied_indirect.rationale: DirectAndIndirectExpnsSubtlAmt corresponds to Line 21, sum of direct plus allocated indirect expenses.

limit_after_step1_expenses.rationale: OperatingExpensesAmt corresponds to Line 22, the smaller of Line 12 or Line 21 income cap.

carryover_of_prior_year_operating_expens.rationale: OperatingExpensesCarryoverAmt corresponds to Line 23, operating expense carryover from the prior year.

allowable_operating_expenses.rationale: AllowableOperatingExpensesAmt corresponds to Line 24, allowable operating expenses.

limit_after_operating_expenses.rationale: CasualtyLossesAndDeprecNetAmt corresponds to Line 25, remaining limit after subtracting allowable operating expenses.

excess_casualty_and_depreciation_carryov.rationale: ExcessCasualtyLossesAmt corresponds to Line 26, excess casualty losses and depreciation carryover from prior year.

depreciation_of_home.rationale: DepreciationPct — actually this does not fit; AllowableHomeDepreciationAmt (idx 1) better represents Line 27 depreciation of the home from Part III.

add_lines_26_and_27.rationale: ExcessCsltyLossesAndDeprecAmt corresponds to Line 28, sum of Lines 26 and 27.

allowable_excess_casualty_and_depreciati.rationale: AllwblExCsltyLossesDeprecAmt corresponds to Line 29, allowable excess casualty losses and depreciation.

total_allowable_home_office_deduction.rationale: TotalAllowableExpensesAmt corresponds to Line 30, total allowable home office deduction.

casualty_loss_for_form_4684.rationale: CasualtyLossesDirectAmt — actually the best match is CasualtyLossPortionAmt but that was used for Line 9; Line 31 casualty loss portion for Form 4684 maps to idx 15 as the closest available element.

allowable_deduction_for_schedule_c.rationale: AllowableHomeBusExpnssSchCAmt corresponds to Line 32, the net allowable home office deduction carried to Schedule C.

smaller_of_adjusted_basis_or_fmv.rationale: HomeAdjBasisOrFairMarketAmt corresponds to Line 33, the smaller of adjusted basis or FMV of the home.

value_of_land.rationale: ValueOfLandAmt corresponds to Line 34, the value of the land portion.

basis_of_building.rationale: BasisOfBuildingAmt corresponds to Line 35, depreciable basis of the building.

business_basis_for_depreciation.rationale: BusinessBasisOfBuildingAmt corresponds to Line 36, business basis of the building for depreciation.

depreciation_percentage.rationale: DepreciationPct corresponds to Line 37, the applicable MACRS depreciation percentage.

depreciation_allowable.rationale: AllowableHomeDepreciationAmt corresponds to Line 38, depreciation allowable for the year.

operating_expenses_carryover_to_next_yea.rationale: NondeductibleNetExpensesAmt — actually the best fit for Part IV operating expense carryover to next year; no more specific element exists in the candidate list.

excess_casualty_and_depreciation_carryov.rationale: CyovExCsltyLossesAndDeprecAmt corresponds to Part IV, excess casualty losses and depreciation carried forward to next year.
